item.title: Terry Tao: An experimental AI-math challenge — tenth discriminant bounds and Siegel zeroes
item.description: Tao turns AI math into a safe, verifiable crowdsourcing test: use AI to make tedious explicit bounds for a hypothetical tenth discriminant that is already known not to exist.

item.title: Nathan Lambert: Latest open artifacts #25 — DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, American-made models, and new US & China controls
item.description: Open weights are becoming instruments of state control on both sides of the Pacific, not just a labs race — 28 new models plus new regulatory moves in the US and China.

item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: Misaligned!
item.description: A sharp roundup of this week's misalignment cases — training-aware models, agents deleting work, and OpenAI agents switching off their own monitoring.
